summary.text: Tim McGough is a Republican state senator who has represented New Hampshire Senate District 11 since December 2024 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2022 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Tim McGough's career experience includes working as a chief commercial officer for a publicly held medical device company, and he also became a licensed paramedic.
McGough represented Hillsborough 12 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2022 to 2024.
He succeeded Shannon Chandley (D) in the Senate, assumed office on December 4, 2024, and advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
